judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition-of-done artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec addition, and failing acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts`, without making any implementation changes to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still overwrites `lastUsage` instead of accumulating usage across rounds, the newly added acceptance tests fail immediately and `npm test` is broken. Furthermore, the candidate failed to update the `afterModelResponse` hook signature, did not remove the outdated under-counting bullet from `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry. It also placed tests in a separate file rather than extending `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as the reference did.
